caption-buttons.description: On Windows the window has no frame (W8), so the page draws its minimize, maximize and close buttons, as BandBridge's window does. Maximize asks whether the window is maximized, to draw the restore glyph. Close quits the editor. macOS draws its own buttons, so it gets none of this.

window.description: The page draws the title bar, as BandBridge's window does, so the bar moves the window, and a double click on it zooms the window, as a title bar does. The toolbar's empty stretches move it too. The page also hears each line of a build or an install as it happens, for its Output drawer. Nothing else.
